subject: Data description entry
notes: kb/Work PB516 (wave 1019 D2). Both sentences of SR16 ('The BASED clause may be specified only in data description entries in the linkage section, in the working-storage section, and in the local-storage section. The level number of such data description entries shall be 1 or 77.', cite.py --check 13.16.3 OK 16)) are ONE Residence row of the clause-placement table (admitted levels [1, 77], sections LINKAGE|WS|LS), asked of a WRITTEN BASED clause by ScreenClausePlacement (COBOL2404; the refusal clears IsBased) and of a BASED clause a TYPE or SAME AS clause composes by ScreenComposedBased (COBOL2510) through the same ClausePlacementRule.ResidenceFault. Before: the level half was a private arm of the BASED block and the SECTION half was asked by nothing, so `FD F. 01 R BASED PIC X(10).` compiled.
